exhibits.title: Professor Septima Vector
exhibits.subtitle: Mistress of Arithmancy
exhibits.text: Welcome. You are starting in the Undercroft. The mathematics everything upstairs is built from. Two wings open here. ARITHMANCY holds the numbers: probability and the bell curve, variance, similarity, frequency, error. CONTINUOUS MOTION holds the geometry of smooth change: curved spaces, the flat tangent planes that touch them, and the exp/log maps that carry you between. Learn a thing down here and you will meet it again upstairs wearing a costume. The bell curve returns as the noise diffusion adds; the dot product returns as attention's score. When the ground feels solid, take a staircase up. The Gatekeeper may ask a question first.

exhibits.title: The Undercroft, Foundations
exhibits.text: The palace grows upward from this floor: every level is built from the one below it. Down here the ideas are pure, no machine learning yet, just the math itself. That is deliberate: an idea learned clean is easy to recognize in disguise. Example: the sliding kernel in this wing is plain convolution; two floors up it reappears moving frames of video. Read a chamber, then follow its staircase to watch the same equation doing a job.

exhibits.title: How to Walk the Palace
exhibits.text: Move with W A S D; look with the mouse. Walk up to any display and press E to study it, diagrams and figures unfold large in the room. E or Esc steps back. M: this floor's map. G: the constellation of every idea in the palace. F: travel to any room by name. N: music. P: footstep trails. Signposts at each doorway point the way; staircases go up toward what is built on this floor. A Gatekeeper ghost may quiz you at a stair, answer, skip, or simply walk on.
